author: steven5703
body:
ETM -- Explode the monument Nebula subtype.

Here's how it works. You have to explode the enemy's monument instead of breaking it. The monument is going to be glowstone but it will have reinforcements around the side of it.
Your team cannot leave their island/platform. There will be TNT, redstone, wood, ect, around the map so you can cannon! The main platform itself will be indistructable, however stuff can be built on top of it and can be exploded. 

"NOT SO FAST! WHAT ABOUT GRIEFERS!?!"
http://avicus.net/forums?topic_id=47
"What if we run out of TnT?"
Each map should have a lot of TnT. So no need to worry.
"I don't know how to cannon... this won't be fun for me!"
If you're not that good at cannoning, you can build super-simple cannons to kill players, not break the monuments. If you don't know simple cannons, each map at spectator spawn should have a sign with a link like "bit.ly/AvicusCannon" that brings you to a tutorial somewhere.
"What if my team shoots TNT at our own monument?"
Well, that'd be hard most likely because of reinforcements and the way monuments are placed on the maps. Upward cannons are a waste of time anyway, and you can always destroy the cannon.
"What if someone starts spamming TNT everywhere?"
Each player will spawn with 4 water buckets to stop griefers (or, hold them back).

Regions:
Monuments: The monument area should be protected so no one can build or go around them.
Spawn island/platform: This would be protected so no one can build or destory. And so tnt can't destory either.
Supply room: Protected like above ^, however tnt can destory so a tatic is to cannon at the enemy's supply room.
Gap between team platforms: This should be about 20 blocks wide, no one can build or enter this area.

Loadouts:
Armor: Full Protection 1 Chain Armor.
Weapons: Power 1 Flame 1 Bow, 1 arrow.
Building blocks/other: 64 stonebricks, 64 planks, 4 water buckets

Nebula Shop:
Nebula shop should stay the same but will have 32 tnt called "TNT Refill" that costs 3 points.

By the way, I'm making a map for this and if this gamemode gets denied I might just switch it over to TDM c;
Special thanks to Adrian for saying in a group chat "i wish you could have different blocks as monument" :>
